simple.meaning: יֶלֶד (yeled) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “something born , i.e. a lad or offspring.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 4:23. The surrounding context includes wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יֶלֶד (H3206) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: יֶלֶד (yeled) / H3206 is traced through Genesis 4:23, Genesis 21:8, Genesis 21:14, Genesis 21:15 with generated occurrence evidence.
